blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III welcomed the ratification of the bicameral conference committee report on the bill proposing the creation of the Presidential Merit College Scholarship Programs (PMSPs), which seeks to give deserving students sustained educational support for college and technical education, including expenses beyond tuition. “Many youth have intelligence, industriousness, and a clear vision, but their families are short of money to spend on education. They should be given the opportunity to finish and use their abilities for their own families and for the country,” Dy said in Filipino in a statement. The reconciled measure, a […]...
